title: Liberales y conservadores
goal: Read what liberals and conservatives actually fought over — the Church's property, communal land, and how many times one country rewrote its own constitution.

items: Name three concrete issues liberals and conservatives disagreed over.
Explain the real-world effect of liberal individual-property policy.

Explain whether either side achieved a lasting, definitive victory.
